decisions.reason: Step 2.3 omits a choice-free justification for selecting minimizers at all budgets. This is nonfatal: the nonempty compact argmin sets in finite-dimensional Euclidean space admit unique lexicographic minima after fixing a finite coordinate order, so no additional choice axiom is mathematically required. Nevertheless the written selection rule was unspecified. Replaced it by nested nonempty closed sets K_k={distortion<=D+1/(k+1), bit information<=L}; compactness via a finite subcover gives one point in their intersection and R(D)<=L, proving right-continuity without selecting a sequence.

The D=0 argument uses h=1/n without declaring a positive index. Under the library zero-based sequence convention this leaves its zeroth event undefined; this is a nonfatal indexing omission, since restricting to positive n or shifting by one gives the identical decreasing family and limit. Repaired to h=1/(n+1), n>=0; the diagonal is joint-full and product-null, proving infinite KL. The positive-distortion Gaussian construction has determinant -ab and expected log-density ratio one half ln(sigma^2/D), and the constant branches cover D>=sigma^2 and zero variance. Statement and AC assumptions are unchanged.

The rejection overlooks thm-it-blahut-arimoto-certified-gap-termination on the same page. Its steps 3.1 and 4.1 telescope KL to prove L_t-L*<=D(q*||q0)/(t+1); steps 5.1 and 6.1 show all cluster points minimize continuous F(q)=-sum p_i ln Z_i(q), and the simplex optimality conditions give s_j<=1 with equality on the support, hence gamma_t->1 even at boundary minimizers. Step 1.2 proves the fixed-t expression enclosures shrink for the specified r^2,-r,r and N=r schedule; thus u_t<=ln gamma_t+1/(t+1)->0. Positive rational tolerance is eventually met. Algorithm properties belong in that separate theorem under SCHEMA.md, so no convergence proof is missing from this definition and no item edit is warranted. The repaired RDF supplier retains its Statement and choice-free result.

The numerical claims are correct, but F1 attributes a backward construction to a supplier Statement exporting only the rate formula, and its unqualified D<1/2 range is false: for p=1/4 and D=3/8 the proposed mass is -1/2. This is nonfatal because all actual uses are D=0 or 1/8 within the valid branch. Removed the overbroad attributed fact and proved the needed construction locally: independent Y~Ber(q), E~Ber(D), X=Y xor E with q=(1/4-D)/(1-2D) gives source mass 1/4 and distortion D. The displayed finite joint-KL sum is h2(1/4)-h2(D), proving attainment and q=1/6 at D=1/8. The zero-rate constant branch and entropy continuity prove the remaining unchanged assertions.

Checked the arbitrary-reconstruction lower bound, Gaussian joint-density calculation, bit conversion, constant branch and zero-variance case; AC is preserved. The recurrence preserves positive divisors and full support, retry and return branches are specified, and no complexity bound is asserted. Its unchanged RDF supplier interface remains valid after the proof-only repair. No algorithm edit is warranted.

Direct substitution, constant-zero reproduction and entropy continuity verify all other claims. Statement unchanged; this is my repair review.
